subject: Post-call: Performance & Geo qualification — clarifying targets and next steps
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bethany Clark <bethany@medcore.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Performance & Geo qualification — clarifying targets and next steps

Hi Bethany —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on a scoped pilot: 

Summary notes:
- Primary concerns: multi-region latency (US/EU/APAC), strict EU data residency for PHI-adjacent traces, and streaming response consistency for clinician-facing features.
- Current peak: ~250 TPS globally for text-generation (burst to 600 TPS for batch jobs overnight).
- Target latency: interactive UX: p50 <= 80ms, p95 <= 220ms; p99 objective TBD based on region.
- Streaming: average token RTT target ~30–60ms for short responses (<= 150 tokens).
- Concurrency: typical concurrent sessions ~180 active users, expected to scale to 700 in Q4.

Attachments: I dropped a short worksheet (medcore_requirements_v1.xlsx) with the numbers you shared and our early SLO suggestions. Please review.

Concrete asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether MedCore requires all customer data + logs to remain within EU for EU patients, or only the model inference payloads? (we noted PHI-adjacent metadata concern)
2) Please confirm whether the 600 TPS overnight bursts include streaming sessions or are purely non-streamed batch generation.
3) If acceptable, Karthik will propose a two-week pilot config with regional routing (EU residency + EU-only model variants for EU traffic), a dedicated concurrency pool for clinical workloads, and a fallback policy to a slightly higher-latency cheaper model for low-priority traffic.

Proposed calendar: can Karthik/Monica do a short tech-scope on Tuesday 9/7 (30 min) to finalize measurable SLOs and sample traffic patterns?

Thanks —

Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: medcore_requirements_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

---
From: Bethany Clark <bethany@medcore.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MedCore Technical <infra@medcore.ai>
Date: 2027-09-05T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Performance & Geo qualification — clarifying targets and next steps

Thanks Avery, appreciate the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- EU residency: for now, we require that any request/response payloads and generated outputs for EU patients stay in-region. Logs that contain identifiers must be redacted or retained in EU; audit logs for platform teams can be replicated to the US but must be encrypted with customer-managed keys.
- The 600 TPS is our batch ingestion window and does not include the streaming clinic UI traffic — that is included in the 250 TPS baseline.
- Token-length distribution: clinician messages are short (mostly under 100 tokens); however, some specialist reports can produce outputs ~400 tokens.

We can do Tues 9/7 10:00–10:30am CET (which should be 1:00–1:30am PDT — maybe not great). Alternatively Wed 9/8 08:00–08:30am PDT works for our infra lead.

I’ll also attach our compliance checklist.

Bethany
Director of Product, MedCore Health
[Attachment: medcore_compliance_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bethany Clark <bethany@medcore.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Performance & Geo qualification — clarifying targets and next steps

Hi Bethany — looping in Monica for infra/ops alignment. I pulled a concise proposal based on your reply and our runtime capabilities. A few concrete clarifying questions before we lock the pilot config: 

Numbers / proposal:
- Latency SLOs (per-region):
  • US: p50 <= 60ms, p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 350ms
  • EU: p50 <= 70ms, p95 <= 230ms, p99 <= 420ms (EU-only model pinning & local KV cache)
  • APAC: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 330ms, p99 <= 700ms (edge nodes + optional local warm pools)
- Streaming RTT: aim for 40ms median token RTT in region; for APAC we anticipate 80–120ms median without edge presence.
- Throughput & concurrency config for pilot: reserve a dedicated pool sized for 400 concurrent streaming sessions and 700 TPS burst capacity with autoscale headroom.
- Fallback policy: requests exceeding concurrency cap route to a higher-latency batch model (same functionality, lower throughput cost).

Questions: 
1) For EU residency, do you require that KMS keys for logs be customer-managed and restricted to EU HSMs? If so, we’ll include that in the pilot scope.
2) Are there particular SLA export formats or monitoring integrations you prefer (e.g., Prometheus endpoints, Datadog tags, or S3 log exports)?
3) Any constraints on cold-start (we can pre-warm model warm pools) or limits on pre-warm GPU hours?

If that aligns, Monica and I can deliver an exact pilot config + cost estimate and a short runbook for the Tuesday/Wed tech session. Proposed time: Wed 2027-09-08 08:00 PDT — does that work?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

---
From: Bethany Clark <bethany@medcore.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MedCore Technical <infra@medcore.ai>, procurement@medcore.ai
Date: 2027-09-06T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Performance & Geo qualification — clarifying targets and next steps

Thanks Karthik — that proposed split looks sensible. Quick answers inline: 
- KMS: yes, customer-managed keys in EU HSMs for any logs that contain identifiers — we will provide the key material during onboarding.
- Monitoring: Datadog is preferred; S3 exports for audit logs would be good as a secondary option.
- Pre-warm budget: we have a limited pre-warm allowance for the pilot (up to 60 GPU-hours) — beyond that we need to add to procurement.

Wed 9/8 08:00 PDT works for our infra lead. Please send a calendar invite and an agenda (15 min objective, 15 min open Q&A). I’ll have our compliance owner on the call for the KMS/retention bits.

Also attaching a short signed NDA addendum and our procurement template for redlines. I’ll review the cost estimate once you share it.

Best,
Bethany
